_about: The tools Études ships. The home page, the docs sidebar and the docs index read this list; a new tool is one new entry. description is the short line for the docs; what is the home page's "<tool> is ..." sentence. crate is the folder whose Cargo.toml gives the install version. Each command's usage must be a line of that tool's captured help in site/transcripts.json; transcript names a captured run whose output the home page shows.

tools.name: sweep
tools.description: Sorts a messy folder into groups, and moves nothing until you have seen the plan.
tools.what: sweep is a command that sorts a messy folder into groups. It moves nothing until you have seen the plan, and it can put the moves back.

commands.says: Builds a plan and shows it. Changes nothing.
Moves every group in the plan.
Reverses the most recent apply in that folder.

tools.name: stash
tools.description: Moves files out of the way without deleting them, and brings them back.
tools.what: stash is a command that moves files out of the way without deleting them. It brings them back when you ask.

commands.says: Moves the folder's visible items into a hidden holding folder, due back in 3 days.
Shows what is stashed, and when it is due back.
Restores the batch for that folder.

tools.name: unpack
tools.description: Opens an archive into one clean folder, or places nothing at all.
tools.what: unpack is a command that opens an archive into one clean folder. If the archive is unsafe, it places nothing at all.

commands.says: Shows what is inside. Extracts nothing.
Extracts into the folder you name.
